content.short: Link3 is a Web3 social network of verifiable identities to build.
content.description: Web3 community building needs a shift from short-term speculation to lasting, trust-based connections that empower members to contribute over time. Link3 leverages W3ST (Web3 Status Token), a non-transferable NFT with an on-chain issuer reference, to help communities elevate signal over noise and cultivate meaningful, verifiable engagement. When paired with Link3's event planner, W3ST enhances existing Twitter or Discord events with Web3-native incentives that reward genuine participation and strengthen the community's shared identity.
